title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Incorrect field breakdown for RPL rules
description: The breakdown '(Rule ID + Hop Limit + endpoint IIDs + ports)' is wrong for Rules 3/4. These rules compress RPL DIO/DAO over ICMPv6 (type 155), not UDP - there are no ports. The breakdown appears to be copy-pasted from a UDP-based rule.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed field breakdown from 'Rule ID + Hop Limit + endpoint IIDs + ports' to 'Rule ID + Hop Limit + endpoint IIDs + RPL fields'. Rules 3/4 compress RPL DIO/DAO over ICMPv6 (type 155), not UDP, so ports do not apply.
